item.title: Write Narration From The Clip

turns.text: Watch this and write a short English voice-over explaining what's happening. Replace the original conversation with your narration, friendly and matter-of-fact. Keep all 10 seconds of footage unchanged, with no music or captions. You pick the wording and voice.

item.tests: Tests deriving a grounded narration from an attached clip and delivering it mixed into the original video with the original dialogue removed.

answer_sheet.What the narration should describe: The two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the Monday start time of nine.
answer_sheet.Original sound: Remove the original conversation and replace it with narration.
answer_sheet.Video duration and framing: Keep all 10 seconds and preserve the source framing and sequence.
answer_sheet.Music, captions, and lip synchronization: No music or captions; do not alter the footage to match the narrator's mouth movements.

must_haves: The final video retains the original two coworkers, office setting, shot sequence, and 10-second duration.
An intelligible English narrator explains that the coworkers are discussing a schedule change and that Mondays now start at nine.
The narration does not invent names, job roles, or additional schedule changes unsupported by the clip.
The original man-and-woman conversation is no longer audible beneath the narration.
The narration fits within the video without a clipped ending, and no music or captions are added.

Should it play over the clip as narration, or should the speaker’s lips match the new audio?
dialog.user: explain the two coworkers discussing the new schedule, including the monday start time of nine. wording’s your call.

dialog.agent:
“Two coworkers are going over the new work schedule and confirming the updated hours. On Monday, the workday starts at nine a.m.”

I can provide the wording, but the connected tools don’t offer a way to generate narration and layer it onto your existing clip without changing the video.

turns.agent:
I tried, but Magic Hour refused the edit because your account has insufficient credits. No video was created or changed.

The attempted narration was: “Two coworkers discuss the new schedule. Monday starts at nine a.m.”
